title: itembank course graph sidecar
description: The published contract for the structured portions of a course root's course-graph.md sidecar. The sidecar itself is plain Markdown pipe tables, readable and diffable by hand; this schema describes the records those tables carry once read. One rule is deliberately absent: the downgrade of an unregistered edge type to an advisory recommended-before is not expressible in the keyword subset schema_validate.py supports, so it lives only in graph.validate_edge. Expressing it here would need a conditional keyword the validator refuses outright, turning a green schema check into a hard SchemaError, and a validator that checks half a contract while reporting green is worse than no validator at all.

sources.description: Sources this course graph refers to. A source's rights live on the source object in the operation journal, never in this table.

edges.description: Edges that relate two independently identified objects.

migrations.description: Recorded migration proposals and their dispositions.

graph_schema_version.description: The graph schema version this sidecar declares. A build refuses a version above the one it understands rather than silently dropping fields it does not know.

course_object_id.description: The course object's minted opaque id.

label.description: A local structural label such as program, semester, module, week, unit, or chapter. The value is deliberately unconstrained: GRAPH-01 requires a local label to be accepted without a schema change.

parent.description: The parent container's id, or empty for a top-level container.

order.description: The authored position within the parent, as written.

container.description: The containing container's id, or empty when unplaced.

order.description: The authored position within the container, as written.

origin.description: Whether this objective was authored locally or imported from a scope or framework.

import_version.description: The imported scope version this objective came from, when it was imported.

overlays.description: Local overlays applied over an imported objective.

source.description: One source this course graph refers to.

source_object_id.description: The source object's minted opaque id.

note.description: A free-text note about this reference.

edge.description: One edge relating two independently identified objects. An edge carries no minted id: its identity is the tuple of source, edge_type, and target.

edge_type.description: The relation, from the frozen four-name vocabulary. A row carrying a name outside this set is kept and read as an advisory recommended-before by graph.validate_edge; that downgrade is not expressible here.

rationale.description: Why this relation was asserted. May be empty.

override.description: How strongly this relation binds. A hard gate is the exceptional case a human writes explicitly; it is never a default and is never reachable from an unrecognized edge type.

binding_kind.description: Whether this binds a source or a treatment.

source_object_id.description: The bound source's id, when one is bound.

locator.description: Where inside the source this binding points.

state.description: How well this objective is covered. There is deliberately no verified and no assumed member: coverage is reported, never claimed.

confidence.description: How confident this coverage judgement is.

rights_snapshot.description: The rights state recorded at binding time, for the record. The authority is always the source object's own rights record, never this copy.

migration.description: One recorded migration proposal and its disposition.

from.description: The objective ids this migration moves from, as written.

to.description: The objective ids this migration moves to, as written.

state.description: The proposal's disposition. A proposal is never applied without an explicit acceptance.

actor.description: Who proposed or decided this migration.
